notes:
Residents: Statistik Austria INSPIRE register-based 100 m population grid
(measured counts, ETRS89-LAEA mesh), aggregated to 300 m demand points placed at
the activity-weighted centroid of their constituent cells. Workplace: no free
official grid exists for Austria - the Arbeitsstaetten/employment rasters are
paywalled - so Vienna's published ~900k employment total is distributed over OSM
office, retail, industrial and institutional features using generic European
per-type employment densities, i.e. a fine building-type dasymetric with
non-locally-calibrated weights. O/D: not observed. Flows come from a
doubly-constrained gravity model (Furness/IPF balancing, exponential distance
decay) calibrated so the modelled commute matches Vienna's published median -
result 6.7 km mean straight-line, 10.2 min median driving time. Driving times and
distances routed with OSRM over the OSM road network. Special demand hand-curated:
airport, 18 university/FH campuses, 12 hospitals, venues, and 7
outside-connection corridors for Umland in-commuters. Geometry built with depot;
buildings from Overture release 2026-07-22.0 with three-tier height imputation
filling the ~48% of footprints carrying neither a height nor a floor count.
